query: Which surah is known as the 'Tent of the Qur'an' (Fustat al-Qur'an)?
gold_answer_reference: Surah Al-Baqarah is known as the 'Tent of the Qur'an' (Fustat al-Qur'an), as reported in a narration from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and others in classical tafsir works such as Tafsir al-Tabari.

query: Is ablution (wudu) required after eating sheep meat before praying in sheep pens?
gold_answer_reference: Ablution is not required after eating sheep meat, and it is permissible to pray in sheep pens, as there is no evidence in the Sunnah mandating wudu after eating sheep meat (Sahih Muslim 360).

query: What was the outcome when Hamza al-Zayyat presented to the Prophet (peace be upon him) in a dream the narrations he heard from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, and what does this indicate about the authenticity of those narrations?
gold_answer_reference: When Hamza al-Zayyat presented the narrations he heard from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash to the Prophet (peace be upon him) in a dream, the Prophet recognized only a few—five or six—of them. This indicates that most of the narrations Hamza heard from Aban were not known or accepted, casting doubt on their authenticity.

query: In Islamic inheritance, how many shares do the deceased's sisters through the father receive if the estate is divided into 612 shares and all debts and bequests have been settled with the heirs' approval?
gold_answer_reference: The sisters through the father receive 184 shares out of 612, as per the rules of Islamic inheritance (al-Farāʾiḍ) detailed in Qur'an 4:11-12 and classical jurisprudence, after debts and bequests are settled and the remainder is distributed among the heirs.

query: What is the Islamic ruling on harboring suspicion or ill thoughts about fellow Muslims?
gold_answer_reference: Harboring suspicion or ill thoughts about fellow Muslims is prohibited, as stated in the Qur'an (Surah Al-Hujurat 49:12): 'O you who have believed, avoid much suspicion. Indeed, some suspicion is sin.'

query: ما هي السورة التي تُسمى فسطاط القرآن؟
gold_answer_reference: سورة البقرة هي السورة التي تُسمى فسطاط القرآن كما ورد عن عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه في سنن الترمذي (2878).

query: لماذا كان أبو هريرة يغسل يديه حتى يبلغ إبطيه في الوضوء؟
gold_answer_reference: لأنه سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: تبلغ حِلية المؤمن حيث يبلغ الوضوء، كما في حديثه في صحيح مسلم (250).

query: What is the ruling on voluntary fasting before making up for missed days in Ramadan?

gold_answer_reference.maliki: The Maliki school considered it permissible but disliked it, due to the delay of a mandatory act.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: The Hanafi school allowed voluntary fasting before making up missed days from Ramadan without it being disliked, as making up for missed days is not immediately obligatory.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: The Shafi'i school considered it permissible but disliked it, due to the delay of a mandatory act.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: The Hanbali school held the view that voluntary fasting before making up missed days from Ramadan is prohibited and not valid, even if there is ample time for making it up.

query: What is the ruling on delaying the prayer beyond its prescribed time without an excuse?

gold_answer_reference.maliki: In the Maliki school, delaying the prayer beyond its designated time without a legitimate excuse is regarded as a serious sin. The individual must repent sincerely and feel remorseful for the negligence.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: Delaying the prayer beyond its prescribed time without an excuse is considered a grave sin, and it necessitates sincere repentance and feeling regret over the negligence committed by the individual.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: The Shafeii school holds that delaying the prayer beyond the appointed time without an excuse is a significant sin, and the person should engage in honest repentance and experience regret for their negligent actions.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: The Hanbali position is that delaying the prayer beyond its specified time without any valid excuse is considered a grave sin, which requires the person to sincerely repent and feel regret for their negligence in fulfilling this obligation.

query: What is the ruling on the grandfather's guardianship in marriage?

gold_answer_reference.maliki: The Maliki school believes that the grandfather does not have the right to compel his granddaughter, whether she is minor or adult, virgin or non-virgin, sane or insane.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: The Hanafi school agrees concerning minors, insane, and mentally impaired individuals, even if they consider her a non-virgin, that the grandfather has guardianship.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: The Shafi'i school opines that the grandfather is like the father in the absence of the father, and he is the most rightful of the guardians after the father in the guardianship of marriage, with the right to compel his virgin granddaughter, whether she is adult or minor.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: The Hanbali school believes that the grandfather does not have the right to compel his granddaughter, whether she is minor or adult, virgin or non-virgin, sane or insane.

query: What is the ruling on forgetting a Sunnah of ablution?

gold_answer_reference.maliki: In the Maliki school, forgetting a Sunnah during ablution does not invalidate the ablution. While Sunnah acts are encouraged, missing them does not compromise the ablution’s validity.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: In the Hanafi school, forgetting a Sunnah in ablution does not invalidate the ablution. The performance of the Sunnah acts is recommended but not obligatory, thus their omission does not affect the validity of the ablution.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: According to the Shafeii school, the omission of a Sunnah in ablution does not affect its validity. Forgetting such acts is allowed while the core aspects must be maintained.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: The Hanbali school holds that missing a Sunnah in ablution does not invalidate it. The ablution remains valid as long as the essential components are fulfilled.

query: Is Hajj still a must for a woman without a husband or mahram?

gold_answer_reference.maliki: The Malikis hold that Hajj is obligatory for her if she finds a husband, a mahram, or a trustworthy group.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: The Hanafis state that Hajj is not obligatory for a woman without a husband or mahram because if she does not have a husband or mahram, her safety cannot be guaranteed.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: Shafi'is hold that Hajj is obligatory for her if she finds a husband, a mahram, or a trustworthy group.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: It is not obligated on her to perform Hajj because if she does not have a husband or mahram, her safety cannot be guaranteed.

query: هل يجوز التَّطَوُّعُ بِالصَّوْمِ قَبْل قَضَاءِ رَمَضَانَ؟

gold_answer_reference.maliki: وَذَهَبَ الْمَالِكِيَّةُ إِلَى الْجَوَازِ مَعَ الْكَرَاهَةِ، لِمَا يَلْزَمُ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْوَاجِبِ
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: فَذَهَبَ الْحَنَفِيَّةُ إِلَى جَوَازِ التَّطَوُّعِ بِالصَّوْمِ قَبْل قَضَاءِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ كَرَاهَةٍ، لِكَوْنِ الْقَضَاءِ لاَ يَجِبُ عَلَى الْفَوْرِ
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: وَذَهَبَ الشَّافِعِيَّةُ إِلَى الْجَوَازِ مَعَ الْكَرَاهَةِ، لِمَا يَلْزَمُ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْوَاجِبِ
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: ذَهَبَ الْحَنَابِلَةُ إِلَى حُرْمَةِ التَّطَوُّعِ بِالصَّوْمِ قَبْل قَضَاءِ رَمَضَانَ، وَعَدَمِ صِحَّةِ التَّطَوُّعِ حِينَئِذٍ وَلَوِ اتَّسَعَ الْوَقْتُ لِلْقَضَاءِ

query: هل يعتبر تأخير الصلاة عن وقتها بدون عذر ذنبًا؟

gold_answer_reference.maliki: اتفق الفقهاء على أن تأخير الصلاة عن وقتها بدون عذر يُعتبر ذنبًا عظيمًا لا يُرفع إلا بالتوبة والندم على ما فرط فيه العبد. وقد سمى النبي ﷺ من فعل ذلك مفرطًا، أي مقصرًا، حيث قال: "لَيْسَ التَّفْرِيطُ فِي النَّوْمِ، إِنَّمَا التَّفْرِيطُ فِي الْيَقَظَةِ".

query: ما هو حكم ولاية الْجَدِّ فِي النِّكَاحِ

gold_answer_reference.maliki: وَذَهَبَ الْمَالِكِيَّةُ  إِلَى أَنَّ الْجَدَّ لَيْسَ كَالأَْبِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْبُرَ بِنْتَ ابْنِهِ سَوَاءٌ أَكَانَتْ صَغِيرَةً أَمْ كَبِيرَةً، بِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا، عَاقِلَةً أَمْ مَجْنُونَةً.
gold_answer_reference.hanafi: ذَهَبَ الحنفية إِلَى أَنَّ الْجَدَّ كَالأَْبِ عِنْدَ عَدَمِ الأَْبِ، وَأَنَّهُ أَحَقُّ الأَْوْلِيَاءِ بَعْدَ الأَْبِ فِي وِلاَيَةِ النِّكَاحِ، وَأَنَّ لَهُ أَنْ يُجْبِرَ بِنْتَ ابْنِهِ الْبِكْرَ سَوَاءٌ أَكَانَتْ بَالِغَةً أَمْ صَغِيرَةً ام مَجْنُونَةِ، اوَمَعْتُوهَةِ، او ان كَانَتْ ثَيِّبًا.
gold_answer_reference.shafeii: ذَهَبَ الشَّافِعِيَّةُ إِلَى أَنَّ الْجَدَّ كَالأَْبِ عِنْدَ عَدَمِ الأَْبِ، وَأَنَّهُ أَحَقُّ الأَْوْلِيَاءِ بَعْدَ الأَْبِ فِي وِلاَيَةِ النِّكَاحِ، وَأَنَّ لَهُ أَنْ يُجْبِرَ بِنْتَ ابْنِهِ الْبِكْرَ سَوَاءٌ أَكَانَتْ بَالِغَةً أَمْ صَغِيرَةً.
gold_answer_reference.hanbali: وَذَهَبَ الْحَنَابِلَةُ إِلَى أَنَّ الْجَدَّ لَيْسَ كَالأَْبِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْبُرَ بِنْتَ ابْنِهِ سَوَاءٌ أَكَانَتْ صَغِيرَةً أَمْ كَبِيرَةً، بِكْرًا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا، عَاقِلَةً أَمْ مَجْنُونَةً.
